title: Don’t Buy This MSFS Marketplace Scam! 🚨 (Dash 8 Classic & New Additions Review)
description:
If you're still looking to add new wings to your hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020, the marketplace has thrown a very interesting—and highly controversial—curveball this week. We are breaking down four completely new additions, ranging from a classic regional turboprop to a vintage military piston trainer, plus a specialized audio upgrade.

But once again, we have to address a massive red flag sitting right at the top of the "Featured" list: the 777-8 Enhanced Edition by M Scenery. Despite carrying an immediate 5-star rating, history tells us exactly what to expect from this developer. Let’s protect your digital wallet, look behind the wall of questionable reviews, and see which packages are actually worth your hard-earned money.

AIRCRAFT & ADD-ONS FEATURED:
• Virtualcol Dash 8 Classic Bundle (Includes Series -100, -200, and -300 with Working Title FMS integration).
• MScenery 777-8 Enhanced Edition (Approach with extreme caution!).
• DHM Sound Pack for CowanSim Bell 206 Lima 3 Helicopter.
• Uniform Hotel India CG6 Primary Trainer (Requires free PMS750 plugin for optional GPS).

Which of these caught your eye? Are you taking the Dash 8 out on regional routes or upgrading your helicopter audio? Drop your thoughts in the comments below!
